## About
J. Howard Automotive, LLC is a family-owned shop delivering honest and professional auto repair and maintenance to the people of Independence and surrounding areas. We understand your vehicle is a major investment, so we care for each customer's vehicle as if it were our own.
Our ASE-certified technicians use today's latest automotive technology. As a certified NAPA AutoCare Center, we bring you the benefits of an established national company with the personal touch of a local family business.
Neighbors have rated us 4.8 from 72 reviews on Google. Come by and visit our clean and professional shop in Independence.

## Services
- Oil and Oil Filter Service: Regular oil and filter changes, an essential way to protect your engine.
- Cooling System Service: We flush the cooling system, run a pressure test and check hoses, caps and connections.
- Air Conditioning Service: We inspect your air conditioner, lines, evaporator and compressor for leaks and wear.
- Fuel/Air Induction Clean-up: Using specialized equipment, we clean the intake manifold, ports, intake valves and combustion chamber to help restore lost power and performance.
- Transmission Service: A cleaner lifts varnish and sludge from the valve body, torque converter and lines, then we install new fluid with conditioners.
- Power Steering Flush: We dissolve gum and varnish, flush out old fluid and put in fresh fluid with anti-wear ingredients.
- Driveline Service: We remove old, worn-out gear oil from the differentials and transfer cases.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you work on foreign and domestic cars?
A: Yes. Our technicians handle all major and minor repairs on foreign and domestic vehicles.

Q: Will I know the cost before you start?
A: Yes. As a NAPA AutoCare Center, we get your authorization and give you a price estimate before the work is done.

Q: How do I schedule an appointment?
A: Give us a call or send us an email and we'll set up your next appointment.
